subject: Tiamat

evidence.quote: This achievement only triggers if you *use* the Bane Sword (or Bane spell). Just attacking and killing Tiamat with the Bane Sword equipped won't earn this achievement.

subject: Choking Hazard

evidence.quote: I upgraded my classes (Redmage to Redwizard) and went straight to Mirage Tower, got the Banesword for RedWizard and encountered Tiamat. Used the Banesword on him. Worked immediately.
